notes:
Verdict by the registered rule: the proxy rises with temperature, its coefficient in the shootings model is positive (0.229, 0.181 to 0.277 per unit of log complaints), A = 0.440 (0.327 to 0.564) on 6087 days, and the year-by-month sensitivity stays above 0.25. Shootings IRR per 5 C falls from 1.151 (1.132 to 1.170) to 1.082 (1.060 to 1.104). Sensitivity: year-by-month terms 0.322 (0.214 to 0.438); without 2020-2021 0.335; May-September 0.203; proxy lagged one day 0.254. The secondary proxy disagrees: bicycle counts (IRR 1.197 (1.182 to 1.213) per 5 C, 4508 days from 2014) give A = 0.039 (-0.048 to 0.132). 311 public drinking complaints, registered under heat-mech-intox, also rise with heat (IRR 1.210 (1.191 to 1.229)) and give A = 0.031 (-0.009 to 0.073). So a series that rises with heat does not by that fact remove the slope; the noise complaints share day-to-day variation with shootings that the other two series lack. This is mediation by proxy. Exploratory, run after the outcome: with a spline of temperature, adding the noise proxy lowers the rise in shootings from 15 to 21 C from 1.303 (1.253 to 1.355) to 1.153 (1.100 to 1.208) and from 21 to 27 C from 1.251 (1.213 to 1.289) to 1.167 (1.130 to 1.206), and leaves the rise from 27 to 33 C unchanged (1.126 (1.069 to 1.185) and 1.138 (1.081 to 1.197)). Bicycle panel sensors per year: {'2014': 8, '2015': 9, '2016': 9, '2017': 12, '2018': 11, '2019': 13, '2020': 14, '2021': 14, '2022': 14, '2023': 19, '2024': 25, '2025': 25, '2026': 17}.

After the referee (13 Nov 2026): the share removed by street-noise complaints is not stable over time. It is 0.24 (0.14 to 0.37) in 2010 to 2019, just under the 0.25 threshold, and 0.84 (0.51 to 1.36) in 2022 to 2026 (referee; re-run). The pooled 0.44 averages two regimes of 311 use, and the registered sensitivity without 2020 and 2021 (0.335) does not show this. On the 2010 to 2019 data alone the claim would have been unsettled. A negative control was run: next-day complaints, which today's street activity cannot cause, remove 0.10 (0.05 to 0.16) of the slope, and complaints seven days later or earlier remove 0.007 and 0.004. A small part of the same-day share therefore comes from variation that complaints and shootings share over a few days. After 2020 complaints are four to ten times their 2010 to 2014 level; either the proxy became a better measure of street gatherings, or complaints now respond to the same gatherings, disorder and police presence that go with shootings, which is a common cause and not a step from heat. The data cannot separate the two. Of three proxies that rise with heat, only this one removes the slope. The graph_effect entry records Kim 2022's rural odds ratio (0.95); the urban value, 0.98 (0.97 to 1.00), is the relevant one for New York, and the study concerns habitual walking over a week in Korea, so no comparison of size can be made.

After the referee of heat-night-minimum (13 Nov 2026): the shootings series of this claim is counted by calendar date, so it includes shootings between 00:00 and 05:59 that precede the day's maximum (35% of incidents). The referee of heat-night-minimum raised this. With shootings assigned to the night-of day (06:00 to 05:59) and the registered procedure otherwise unchanged (500 week resamples, seed 1), the share removed by street-noise complaints is 0.53 (0.41 to 0.66) against 0.44 (0.33 to 0.56) as registered, and 0.41 (0.30 to 0.54) with year-by-month terms (registered 0.32). The shootings slope is 1.143 (1.123 to 1.162) per 5 C and 1.065 (1.042 to 1.088) with the proxy. Complaints created between 00:00 and 05:59 are 28% of the total; with complaints moved to the night-of day as well the share is 0.55 (0.44 to 0.69), and 0.46 (0.36 to 0.60) with year-by-month terms. Every registered condition is met under each assignment, so the calendar-day count did not produce the confirmation; the share is larger on night-of counts. The instability over time that the first referee found was not re-examined on night-of counts. The hot-end comparison is weaker than reported. The rise in shootings from 27 to 33 C, scored above as 1.122 (1.072 to 1.173), is 1.090 (1.041 to 1.141) on night-of counts with the same 4-df spline and 1.051 (0.988 to 1.118) with the piecewise-linear basis of round 2, whose interval includes 1. Complaints and bicycle counts still stop rising at 27 C; the excess in shootings that they do not explain is a quarter to a half smaller on the log scale than stated, and part of the stated excess is shootings after midnight on the hot date. Exploratory, run after the outcomes, and deciding nothing under rule 4 (analyses/critique/round5_night_of_check.py; data/derived/round5/heat_night/night_of_check.json).
verdict_note: Confirmed on the pooled 2010 to 2026 series. The share is 0.24 in 2010 to 2019 and 0.84 in 2022 to 2026, and a next-day negative control removes 0.10.
